# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster learns nature and history of any 1 plant.
@@ 2
Allows caster to increase speed of growth for any 1 species of plant within
the area of effect by 10 times.
@@ 3
Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 plant species.
@@ 4
Heals damage to one plant that is less complex than a tree (especially severe
damage may get a RR to avoid the effects of this spell, GM discretion).
@@ 5
As Speed Growth I, except growth rate is 100 times normal.
@@ 6
Caster can locate members of any 1 species of plant or he can find out what
species are in the area of effect.
@@ 7
Allows caster to double the size of any 1 plant. The growth takes place over
the course of 1 day.
@@ 8
Caster can control the automatic and/or mental processes of any 1 plant. The
caster can also control the plant’s movements, though this spell doesn’t allow
movement beyond normal allowances.
@@ 9
As Speed Growth I, except the area of effect is 100' radius, and the range is
100'.
@@ 10
As Plant Growth I, except size increase is 3 times.
@@ 11
As Plant Control I, except caster can control any 3 plants.
@@ 12
As Plant Restore, except it can affect any plant (including trees).
@@ 13
As Plant Growth I, except size increase is 5 times.
@@ 14
As Speed Growth II, except the area of effect is 100' radius and the range is
100'.
@@ 15
As Plant Control I, except caster can control any 5 plants.
@@ 16
Summons a wall of very tough (but pliable) thorns. The wall is up to 10' x 10'
x 5'. Anyone moving through the wall receives d10 dagger attacks (use a +50
dagger attack on the Dagger Attack Table from Arms Law, if available) per foot
of wall moved through. The wall must rest on a solid surface.
@@ 17
This spell will put out any fires upon living materials that are in the area
of effect.
@@ 18
As Plant Growth I, except size increase is 10 times.
@@ 20
As Plant Growth I, except affects all plants in the area of effect.
@@ 25
As Speed Growth I, except for the range and area of effect.
@@ 30
As Plant Control I, except caster can control all plants within the area of
effect.
@@ 50
Caster can animate any 1 plant. The plant can then move slowly, carrying any
root system it may possess along.
